supersedes.reason: v5 signed-conjugate diagnostics, including observed status counts and numeric traces, were excluded before any accepted scientific outcome because the stochastic negative branch was outside the production Hermitian positive-kernel source-correlation model. v6 keeps the representable proper-complex positive-overlap model, retains the exact analytic ValidationCoupling::Negative DAG/source-factor oracle, and prospectively evaluates the unchanged 0.95 emission gate on fresh seed indices 512 through 1023.

seed_schedule.selection_rule: exactly the 24 listed stochastic cells receive 128 seeds; every listed deterministic contract cell receives one seed; no label-based inference and no top-up
seed_schedule.precision: for n=128 and target coverage 0.95, accept covered counts 117 through 126 inclusive: the intersection of the central exact-binomial 95 percent acceptance region and counts whose two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval contains 0.95

deterministic_behavior_evidence.coincident: stochastic coincident cells and exact-zero contracts
deterministic_behavior_evidence.topology: one, two, four, capped-eviction, and partial-final block cells
deterministic_behavior_evidence.provenance: whole and bounded HDF5 semantic parity fixtures

execution_protocol.regeneration: derive every request, full raw DGP, latent noiseless target/reference histories, and deterministic-fixture dense 2N phase-joint oracle from the frozen DGP generator identity, cell_id, and seed_index; receipt/scorer metadata cannot change raw bytes
execution_protocol.commit_rule: each cell summary atomically commits after exact regenerated request order, raw DGP and latent-history comparison, deterministic analytic or stochastic online empirical operator validation, E C E-prime validation, attempt digest, count, and scope validation; one whole-frame and one bounded production HDF5 parity fixture commit at run scope
execution_protocol.resume_rule: reuse requires Rust spatial_covariance_batch replay from seed zero and exact regenerated attempt digest plus byte-identical independently recomputed summary; without that executable the cell is not reusable
execution_protocol.manifest_read: read bounded bytes once with pre/open/post identity checks, then hash and parse those same bytes; each whole-frame and bounded run-scope production HDF5 is streamed once under its frozen per-artifact cap
execution_protocol.malformed_record_rule: fail current cell without commit; previously committed cells remain reusable only after exact replay

performance_probe.execution: the fresh measurement parent starts its timer before child launch and retains only ordered seed-range descriptors; each child independently regenerates and serializes its assigned at-most-three exact seed requests, runs the exact target/release/examples/spatial_covariance_batch process, and emits one ordered chunk; waves contain at most twelve children; the parent validates every output record and ordered concatenation before stopping the timer, then discards all attempt output
performance_probe.aggregate_rss_sampler: sum ps rss bytes across each live Python generator child and its exact Rust batch descendant every 50 milliseconds

positive_overlap_cohort.execution: stream exactly 512 attempts for the frozen positive-overlap cell at scheduled/request ordinal 13 and preserved DGP ordinal 14 through the exact prebuilt spatial_covariance_batch under an explicit extended replay and accumulator context that does not widen the ordinary 128-seed outcome schedule; a bounded supervisor concurrently drains stdout and stderr, kills and waits on stderr above 16 KiB, bounds stdout to one capped record, and enforces the frozen per-record and final-exit deadlines so missing, partial, stalled, or top-up output fails closed; Python independently regenerates each seed's support, ancestry, latent truth, marginal oracle, correlation receipt, coordinates, shape, counts, and source process; all attempt identities are retained and exact emitted and abstained seed counts/digests are persisted; predicted and empirical numeric traces are reduced only over emitted attempts subject to the frozen minimum emission rate, with no top-ups or fabricated values; the final scorer must rerun all 512 attempts through the exact bound Rust producer and require byte-identical canonical cohort evidence before scoring any shard; the positive-overlap difference trace must be below its own target-plus-reference marginal trace for both predicted and empirical evidence; negative coupling is not represented by this stochastic proper-complex production model and remains covered only by the exact ValidationCoupling::Negative production DAG/source-factor oracle

determinism.dgp_generator_identity_definition: frozen v6 counter-generator identity over the exact preserved 40-entry DGP order with one nonexecutable tombstone; DGP cell ordinal, seed, coordinate, date, and stream are separate counter-key fields
determinism.counter_key: SHA-256(domain || dgp_generator_identity_sha256 bytes || uint64_le dgp_cell_ordinal || uint64_le seed_index || int64_le row || int64_le column || uint32_le date_index || uint16_le stream_byte_count || ASCII stream || uint64_le counter)

dgp_cell_order_tombstone.reason: unsupported stochastic improper signed-source model removed before outcomes

determinism.normal_transform: first uint64_le word of the counter digest; index=word>>(64-index_bits); exact IEEE754 binary64 value loaded from the frozen midpoint inverse-normal LUT; no runtime logarithm, square root, sine, or cosine
determinism.complex_normal: four independent named local streams and four cell-global streams per source-factor halo coordinate/date
determinism.complex_storage: fixed scalar operation order, fused multiply-add prohibited, final real and imaginary components rounded to IEEE754 binary32 before the common frozen phasor
determinism.matrix_order: source coordinates row-major, acquisition ascending, component real then imag; estimate histories target then reference; covariance and online reductions row-major
determinism.numeric_encoding: raw source hashes use canonical little-endian counts, coordinates, and IEEE754 binary32 complex components; negative zero canonicalized positive; NaN and infinity prohibited

numeric_contract.raw_dgp: regenerate every complex look over the complete transitive sequential replay dependency halo through every expected block, including the final source-factor window; compare exact shape, scalar count, full raw-cube and target/reference factor-halo content hashes, primitive support hashes, ancestry hash, DGP identity, and target/reference loading means before scoring
numeric_contract.latent_truth: regenerate noiseless target and reference phase histories from slope_rad_per_day plus fixed positive 0.0002*sin((2*row-column)/11) radians/day, cadence, coordinates, and exact acquisition-zero gauge; coincident coordinates share one identical history
numeric_contract.dense_joint_oracle: Python independently reconstructs the coordinate-keyed primitive source union, signed target/reference influence matrix A, and source correlation matrix R, then derives the full dense 2N phase-joint covariance from noise_variance times A-prime R A and the gauged temporal covariance only for deterministic fixtures; stochastic cells are calibrated against bounded online empirical estimator-error covariance
numeric_contract.estimator_evidence: Rust emits actual EMI or EVD target/reference date histories, predicted production target-minus-reference date covariance, bounded 2N by 2N production phase-joint operator, and exact final-date target-minus-reference contrast weights; estimator_branch must equal the cell estimator
numeric_contract.difference_covariance: Python independently computes the full-date fixed-L2 E C E-prime map from the pre-factor production 2N replay joint operator, symmetrizes, applies the frozen 1e-10 rank threshold, eigenvalue clipping and factor reconstruction, then compares production F F-prime under eps*date_count*256*max(1,max_abs(reconstruction)); actual covariance and replay-operator canonical digests remain exact
numeric_contract.contrast_variance_error: same deterministic or stochastic operator pair projected by exact final-date target-minus-reference weights; maximum relative error 0.10
numeric_contract.empirical_covariance: population covariance sum(error outer error)/n - mean(error) outer mean(error), where error=(estimated_target-estimated_reference)-(latent_target-latent_reference); target and reference marginal error outer products and cross products are also reduced
numeric_contract.predicted_covariance: mean per-attempt production target-minus-reference covariance is compared with online empirical difference-error covariance; the positive-overlap cohort requires predicted and empirical difference traces below their own target-plus-reference marginal traces
numeric_contract.coincident: identical support, raw source content, latent histories, estimated histories, and exact-zero predicted target-minus-reference covariance
numeric_contract.psd: minimum diagonal after independent cyclic Jacobi eigensolver on (M+M^T)/2; sweep p ascending then q ascending; tolerance 1e-14*max(1,max_abs_diagonal); at most 100*n*n sweeps; fail if not converged; compare to -1e-10
numeric_contract.interval_score: per non-gauge date, width+(2/0.05)*(absolute_error-half_width) when absolute_error exceeds half_width
numeric_contract.production_artifact_validation: one whole-frame and one bounded production parity fixture per run are emitted through ProductionCovarianceState, re-read through dolphin-io, stream-hashed with their actual JSON provenance sidecars, and bound separately from the ephemeral attempt stream
numeric_contract.self_attested_metric_policy: no Rust metric, stochastic oracle, realized noisy truth, nested allocation record, or unattached artifact digest is accepted; Python regenerates raw DGP and latent histories, derives deterministic 2N phase-joint oracles, and derives stochastic operator error from bounded online empirical estimator-error covariance
numeric_contract.canonical_hashes: SHA-256 over frozen streaming raw encoding and numeric encodings with domain tags raw-input-v4, source-raw-input-v4, latent-phase-history-v4, estimate-history-v4, predicted-difference-covariance-v4, production-operator-v4, dense-oracle-v4, mean-predicted-covariance-v4, empirical-error-covariance-v4

cell_reducers.attempted_seeds: exactly 128 for each of the 24 explicit stochastic cells and one for every explicit deterministic contract cell
cell_reducers.error_sum: bounded date vector sum over emitted valid difference errors
cell_reducers.error_outer_sum: bounded date-by-date sum of difference-error outer products over emitted valid attempts
cell_reducers.target_reference_error_sums: bounded target-error and reference-error vectors plus target, reference, and target-by-reference error outer-product matrices
cell_reducers.predicted_covariance_sum: bounded date-by-date sum over emitted valid attempts plus scalar target/reference marginal operator traces
cell_reducers.positive_overlap_marginal_trace: sum of target and reference marginal covariance traces over the exact emitted positive-overlap attempts
cell_reducers.psd_min_eigenvalue: minimum over emitted predicted covariance attempts
cell_reducers.coverage_95_by_date: for each 128-seed stochastic cell, every non-gauge date must have 117 through 126 covered attempts inclusive and the Wilson 95 percent interval must contain 0.95; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.final_date_coverage_95: explicit last element of coverage_95_by_date and independently gated
cell_reducers.interval_score_mean_by_date: bounded per-date sums divided by emitted attempts; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.interval_width_mean_by_date: bounded per-date sums divided by emitted attempts; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.final_date_interval_receipts: explicit last elements of per-date interval score and width
cell_reducers.retention: only sums, outer products, per-date count vectors, scalar extrema and marginal traces, artifact/factor/support digests, and streaming digests; no attempts
cell_reducers.masked: one deterministic masked_target contract; pass; zero emission; null estimator, operator, contrast, and covariance evidence
cell_reducers.not_evaluable: only non-masked tied_eigenvalue cells; one deterministic canonical production probe with singular_local_information attempt status

producer_binary_identity.binary_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing the exact streamed SHA-256 and byte count of both prebuilt release executables

raw_proper_complex.temporal_signal: proper-complex AR(1) using frozen binary64 rho and innovation-weight coefficients in fixed scalar order
raw_proper_complex.spatial_stress: signal and measurement-noise local/global proper-complex innovations mixed with weights sqrt(0.5)
raw_proper_complex.phase_formula: frozen common phasor and latent-phase IEEE754 bit tables indexed by (2*row-column,date_index); positive-overlap loading never changes the latent phasor
raw_proper_complex.amplitude_formula: frozen signal-scale IEEE754 bit table indexed by (row+3*column,eigen_stress,date_index)
raw_proper_complex.sampler_seed: portable SHA-256 counter key bound to the frozen DGP generator identity, positive-overlap cell ordinal, seed, coordinate, date, named stream, and counter; support selection reads this same stack

full_replay_dgp.cross_tile_support: global non-negative coordinates span adjacent 256 by 256 native tiles; support and the complete transitive dependency halo are cropped only at the validation mosaic origin, never at an internal native-tile edge
full_replay_dgp.candidate_sources: complete contiguous row-major phase half-window with production inward clamping inside each 256 by 256 native tile, for target union reference before adaptive selection
full_replay_dgp.raw_shape: complete transitive replay dependency halo by complete topology acquisition count by real/imag
full_replay_dgp.dependency_halo_expansions: one phase half-window per expected sequential block, including the final source-factor window
full_replay_dgp.support_generation: run the frozen Rect, GLRT, or KS selector on the positive-overlap production stack separately for every expected ministack real-acquisition slice; hashes bind ordered block_id and row-major realized sources
full_replay_dgp.ancestry: bind every expected ministack block, carried parent identity, complete date axis, acquisition-zero gauge, cap eviction, and partial tail
full_replay_dgp.latent_history: noiseless target/reference coordinate phase histories from the frozen phase formula, date cadence, pair orientation, and exact acquisition-zero gauge
full_replay_dgp.rust_output: actual EMI or EVD target/reference estimated histories plus predicted production target-minus-reference date covariance
full_replay_dgp.coincident: same realized support and raw source content, identical latent and estimated histories, exact zero predicted contrast covariance
full_replay_dgp.comparison: Python regenerates all content/support/ancestry/DGP/latent digests and derives estimator errors, empirical covariance, predicted covariance mean, PSD, intervals, and coverage
full_replay_dgp.factor_sources: for every realized primitive phase source, read a second cell half-window with the same production inward clamping; the raw cube also retains each transitive prior-block phase dependency required by sequential compression replay

source_centered_empirical.half_window: cell half_window around every realized primitive source, production inward-clamped inside its 256 by 256 native tile

effective_looks.covariance_contract: Cov=sum_{s,t} R(s,t) W_s^T W_t, evaluated per sequential source block in its common factor basis
effective_looks.identity_model: R_ab=1 when source_a equals source_b and 0 otherwise
effective_looks.support_union: nonzero_source_adjoint_coordinate union from realized target/reference phase supports and compressed native centers; for nonempty frozen validation cells this equals the complete target/reference candidate source union before adaptive phase selection
effective_looks.independent_recomputation_tolerance: abs(actual-expected) <= 1e-12*max(1,abs(expected)); canonical receipt digests remain exact
effective_looks.fraction_role: diagnostic n/(1^T R 1); never applied as a final scalar covariance inflation
effective_looks.bounded_factorization: query-local per-basis A^T R A with admitted S by S R and two S by selected buffers

coordinates.realized_overlap: intersection_source_count/union_source_count (Jaccard) from exact target/reference support keys per attempt
coordinates.adaptive_supports: target and reference support hashes and counts vary by seed

positive_overlap_spatial_field.field: one positive-overlap cell-global proper-complex innovation with sqrt(0.5) magnitude
positive_overlap_spatial_field.pair_loading: the representable positive-overlap cell loads shared primitive sources with the same orientation on both sides
positive_overlap_spatial_field.none: disjoint source-key cross term exact zero
positive_overlap_spatial_field.sign_field_identity: positive-overlap support and latent-history digests plus independently reduced target/reference marginal and cross estimator-error covariance
positive_overlap_spatial_field.persist: positive signed_cross_influence, target/reference loading means, marginal covariance traces, cross-error covariance trace, and positive-overlap support/latent digests

truth.latent: frozen noiseless target/reference phase histories regenerated independently from the DGP
truth.predicted_covariance: production target-minus-reference date covariance emitted by Rust without a noisy realized truth matrix
truth.coverage_event: latent target-minus-reference history lies inside each non-gauge date interval
truth.attempt_aggregation: bounded error sums, error outer-product sums, predicted covariance sums, counts, and digests only

resource_sampling.raw_measurement_binding: benchmark driver executes the exact named Rust command and captures its bounded stdout byte stream; the raw record binds command, exit status, stdout byte count, stdout SHA-256, exact stdout text, wall seconds, max RSS, sampler, tool outputs, OS, and hardware for every repetition
resource_sampling.allocation_model: parse actual production runtime resource receipt and four named admission components only from captured Rust stdout; caller-fabricated nested allocation records are prohibited
resource_sampling.dependency_cone_binding: captured benchmark stdout block count, maximum sources per block, dependency depth, and reference-cone sources must equal the independently retained cone and canonical SHA-256
resource_sampling.area_axis_rule: production factor block admission is capped before reads; captured area/date sweeps and measured RSS identify growth
resource_sampling.acceptance: captured benchmark stdout dependency, persisted, scratch, final, microbatch and named allocation formulas pass; all measured repetitions <= rss threshold; both independently identifiable exponents <=1.25; RSS corroborates the bound

receipt_contract.masked_target_metrics: signed_cross_influence, estimator histories/covariance, production operator, and contrast weights are null with emitted=false and factor_emitted=false; full raw DGP content/support/ancestry and latent identities remain required
production_artifact_required: one run-root-relative HDF5 path per run
one run-root-relative JSON provenance sidecar path per run
separate in-memory and persisted factor digests
complete capped-read HDF5 header and every-block semantics for whole and bounded artifacts
receipt_contract.retention: only cell summaries with bounded online sums/counts/per-date vectors/digests, shard manifests, run manifest, whole-frame and bounded production parity HDF5 artifacts plus sidecars, performance probe, bounded captured stdout resource receipts, and resource aggregates; ephemeral attempt transport, production operator inputs, source members, and preparation descriptors are durably deleted after verified commit
receipt_contract.verification: regenerate full raw DGP and latent histories for every attempt; use exact independent 2N phase-joint oracle only for deterministic fixtures and bounded online empirical estimator-error covariance for stochastic cells; independently derive E C E-prime, operator and contrast errors, signed cross covariance, PSD, intervals, and coverage; read and hash actual whole-frame and bounded production HDF5 v4 artifacts and manifest v3 sidecars via Rust and bind separate factor/reference/estimator provenance; reuse requires exact Rust replay
receipt_contract.manifest_read: bounded bytes are read once with pre/open/post identity checks, then both hashed and parsed from those exact accepted bytes; HDF5 is stream-hashed once under its cap
receipt_contract.resource_hash: sha256 canonical JSON of complete resource receipt excluding resource_hash; captured benchmark stdout bytes are hash checked and parsed, then every allocation model, dependency cone, microbatch, and component value and hash is independently recomputed
